note: First module list, from next-forge's packages (vendor lock-in removed) plus modules we add. Layer A (common SaaS) and C-support (AI). Pruning by the user pending.

modules.name: auth
modules.scope: accounts, login, sessions, password reset, email verification, MFA basics

modules.name: workspaces-and-permissions
modules.scope: organizations/workspaces, members, invitations, roles, cross-tenant isolation

modules.name: database-and-tenancy
modules.scope: data layer, migrations, tenant-scoped queries, soft delete, backups, transactions and idempotency

modules.name: payments-billing
modules.scope: plans, subscriptions, checkout, webhooks from the payment provider, invoices, entitlements, dunning

modules.name: email-transactional
modules.scope: transactional email: templates, queue, retries, bounces, unsubscribe, deliverability

modules.name: notifications
modules.scope: in-app and push notifications, preferences, digests

modules.name: rate-limiting
modules.scope: per-IP and per-account limits, abuse control, 429 behavior

modules.name: web-security
modules.scope: security headers, CSRF, CORS, bot protection, input validation, secrets handling

modules.name: file-storage
modules.scope: uploads, signed URLs, size and type limits, virus scanning, per-tenant access

modules.name: webhooks-outbound
modules.scope: customer-facing webhooks: signing, retries, replay, delivery log

modules.name: observability
modules.scope: structured logs, error tracking, metrics, tracing, no secrets in logs

modules.name: analytics-and-usage
modules.scope: product analytics events, usage metering, per-tenant usage reports

modules.name: feature-flags
modules.scope: flags, gradual rollout, per-tenant overrides, kill switches

modules.name: internationalization
modules.scope: locales, translation workflow, formats, time zones, RTL

modules.name: audit-and-data-export
modules.scope: audit log of sensitive actions, data export, deletion requests, retention

modules.name: ai-model-gateway
modules.scope: calling LLMs from a SaaS: provider config, fake model for tests, streaming, usage accounting, budgets with hard stop, retries and fallbacks, prompt/response logging policy

modules.name: ai-retrieval
modules.scope: knowledge base for AI features: document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, per-tenant retrieval, citations, no fabrication
